title: Recall handling and open recall mentions
summary: This topic centers on recall mentions, with a few clearly negative comments about open recalls or dissatisfaction with how related issues were handled, while most sampled fragments do not provide enough sentiment about recalls themselves.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe concern about an open recall and dissatisfaction with how the recall or related service issue was handled.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention recalls or the word handled in contexts that do not clearly express sentiment about recall experience itself.

limitations: Many sampled fragments are ambiguous because keywords such as recall and handled also appear in unrelated contexts, reducing topic coherence.
Several undetermined examples are too short or incomplete to tell whether the customer felt positively, negatively, or neutrally about a recall.
The sampled reviews are stratified and not representative, so they cannot be used to estimate overall recall experience.
